title: Apple Wallet driver’s license is coming to new US state soon - 9to5Mac
summary: Apple Wallet’s support for digital driver’s licenses keeps expanding, with North Carolina the latest state to announce that it’s launching soon. Beyond North Carolina’s confirmed Apple Wallet support, recently we’ve seen signs of several other states preparing to adopt Wallet IDs.
